topic: Calling the Court to Postpone Jury Duty

script.title: POSTPONING JURY DUTY
script.scene_zh: 電話 · 申請陪審延期
script.story_hook: A letter arrives, and his schedule can't take it.
script.intro_zh: 一封信送來，他的行程根本撐不住這個。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to a call to the court. Listen for postponement phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到打給法院的一通電話。留意申請延期的說法。
script.outro: And the date moved with one call. Listen again and ask along.
script.outro_zh: 一通電話就把日期改好了。再聽一次，跟著一起問。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: an older man in his sixties with thin white hair combed to the side, reading glasses on a cord, a brown corduroy jacket over a checked shirt, grey trousers, and a lean build
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length wavy light brown hair, a small nose stud, a soft lavender blouse, a lanyard ID badge, and an average build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I got a jury letter, I'd like to postpone.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ ɡɑt ə ˈdʒʊɹi ˈlɛɾɚ aɪd laɪk tə poʊstˈpoʊn/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我收到陪審團的信，想申請延期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I can help, do you have your number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ aɪ kən hɛlp du ju hæv jɔɹ ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好的，我可以幫你，你有編號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The number? Um, you mean the one on top?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnʌmbɚ ʌm ju min ði wʌn ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 編號？嗯，你是說最上面那串嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the summons number, it's six digits.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈsʌmənz ˈnʌmbɚ ɪts sɪks ˈdɪdʒɪts/
dialogue.zh: 對，傳票編號，一共六個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, here it is, four seven two...
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ hɪɹ ɪts ˈfɔɹ ˈsɛvən tu/
dialogue.zh: 噢，找到了，四七二……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, I'll type it, go ahead slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑːn aɪl taɪp ɪt ɡoʊ əˈhɛd ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 稍等，我輸入進去，請你唸慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four seven, then nine zero one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹ ˈsɛvən ðɛn naɪn ˈzɪɹoʊ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 四七，然後是九、零、一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, that's you, Mr. Alan Reyes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ðæts ju ˈmɪstɚ ˈeɪlən ˈɹeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，是你對吧，Alan Reyes 先生？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's me, glad the numbers matched up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts mi ɡlæd ðə ˈnʌmbɚz mætʃt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 就是我，還好數字對上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, so why do you need to move it?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ soʊ waɪ du ju nid tə muːv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，那你想改日期的原因是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I run a small shop, I can't close.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɹʌn ə smɔːl ʃɑːp aɪ kænt kloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 我開一家小店，實在走不開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, that's a fair work conflict, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd ðæts ə fɛɹ wɝk ˈkɑnˌflɪkt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 我了解，這是很合理的工作衝突。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, some clerks don't really believe it.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju sʌm klɚks doʊnt ˈɹiːli bɪˈliv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，有些書記官不太肯相信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, small business counts, no worries.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du smɔːl ˈbɪznəs kaʊnts noʊ ˈwɝiz/
dialogue.zh: 我們信的，小商家也算數，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how far can I push the date?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ fɑɹ kən aɪ pʊʃ ðə deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那，我最多能把日期往後延多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually up to six months, no penalty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuːʒuəli ʌp tə sɪks mʌnθs noʊ ˈpɛnəlti/
dialogue.zh: 通常最多六個月，不會罰錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six months sounds doable, well, almost.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks mʌnθs saʊndz ˈduəbl wɛl ˈɔlˌmoʊst/
dialogue.zh: 六個月聽起來可行，嗯，勉強吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any special date you need to avoid?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈspɛʃəl deɪt ju nid tə əˈvɔɪd/
dialogue.zh: 有什麼日子是你特別要避開的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a family trip that week.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈfæməli tɹɪp ðæt wik/
dialogue.zh: 我那星期剛好有趟家庭旅行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which week is that, just so I flag it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wik ɪz ðæt dʒʌst soʊ aɪ flæɡ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是哪一週？我先幫你標記起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The middle of March, if that's okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪdəl ʌv mɑɹtʃ ɪf ðæts oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 三月中那一週，如果沒問題的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll note it, March is tricky anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl noʊt ɪt mɑɹtʃ ɪz ˈtɹɪki ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我會註記，三月本來也很難排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tricky? Is jury duty busy then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɹɪki ɪz ˈdʒʊɹi ˈduti ˈbizi ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 很難排？陪審團那陣子很忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, spring is our busiest season, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs spɹɪŋ ɪz ˈɑɹ ˈbɪzist ˈsizən ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 對，春天是我們最忙的季節，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, that's fine, I just want to avoid it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæts faɪn aɪ dʒʌst wɑnt tə əˈvɔɪd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不會，沒關係，我只是想避開那陣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, let's aim for early February instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ lɛts eɪm fɔɹ ˈɝli ˈfɛbʊˌɛɹi ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 合理，那我們改試二月初好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: February, um, do I still have to come in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɛbʊˌɛɹi ʌm du aɪ stɪl hæv tə kʌm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 二月，嗯，那還是得人到場嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one day, unless they pick you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn deɪ ʌnˈlɛs ðeɪ pɪk ju/
dialogue.zh: 是的，得來一天，除非他們挑上你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick me? For an actual trial, you mean?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk mi fɔɹ æn ˈæktʃuəl ˈtɹaɪəl ju min/
dialogue.zh: 挑上我？你是說真的要陪審一個案子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, most people only wait and go home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt moʊst ˈpipəl ˈoʊnli weɪt ænd ɡoʊ hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 對，多數人只是等一等，然後回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's a relief to hear, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ə ɹɪˈlif tə hɪɹ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 噢，聽了就安心了，老實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some serve a week, but that's rare.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm sɜɹv ə wik bʌt ðæts ɹɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 有人要連續到庭一週，但那很少見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Is there anything I must bring?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ɪz ðɛɹ ˈɛniθɪŋ aɪ mʌst bɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 了解了。有什麼是一定要我帶的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the letter and a photo ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə ˈlɛɾɚ ænd ə ˈfoʊtoʊ aɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 只要那封信和一張有照片的身分證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And what do people normally wear there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌt du ˈpipəl ˈnɔɹməli wɛɹ ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 還有，大家在那裡一般穿什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Casual is fine, just no slippers, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæʒuəl ɪz faɪn dʒʌst noʊ ˈslɪpɚz pliz/
dialogue.zh: 休閒就可以，就是別穿拖鞋，拜託。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, noted, I'll leave the slippers home.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊɾɪd aɪl liv ðə ˈslɪpɚz hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 哈，記下了，拖鞋我會留在家裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, there's a cafe inside if you get hungry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ðɛɹz ə kəˈfeɪ ɪnˈsaɪd ɪf ju ɡɛt ˈhʌŋɡɹi/
dialogue.zh: 好，裡面有咖啡廳，餓了可以吃點東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, will I get paid for missing work?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wɪl aɪ ɡɛt peɪd fɔɹ ˈmɪsɪŋ wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 不錯，那因為請假，他們會給我工資嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The court pays a small daily stipend, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɔɹt peɪz ə smɔːl ˈdeɪli ˈstaɪpɛnd jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 有的，法院會按天付一小筆津貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A stipend? Okay, that helps a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈstaɪpɛnd oʊˈkeɪ ðæt hɛlpz ə ˈlɪɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 津貼？好，那多少有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's small, I won't lie, but it's something.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts smɔːl aɪ woʊnt laɪ bʌt ɪts ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 錢很少，我不騙你，但總比沒有好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understandable. Do I need to prove my job?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstændəbl du aɪ nid tə pɹuːv maɪ dʒɑːb/
dialogue.zh: 能理解。我得證明我有工作嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not today, but keep a letter from work.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt təˈdeɪ bʌt kip ə ˈlɛɾɚ fɹʌm wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 今天不用，但留一封公司開的信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A letter? Like from my boss, in writing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɛɾɚ laɪk fɹʌm maɪ bɔːs ɪn ˈɹaɪɾɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 信件？像是我老闆寫的書面證明？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, in case they ever ask later.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪn keɪs ðeɪ ˈɛvɚ æsk ˈleɪɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對，以防他們之後要查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I can get that no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ kən ɡɛt ðæt noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 好，那個我拿得到，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Now, should I confirm this by mail?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt naʊ ʃʊd aɪ kənˈfɜɹm ðɪs baɪ meɪl/
dialogue.zh: 完美。那我要用信件確認這件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Email is fine, um, if you have it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈiːmeɪl ɪz faɪn ʌm ɪf ju hæv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 用電子郵件就行，嗯，如果你們有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We only mail, no email, it's old rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈoʊnli meɪl noʊ ˈiːmeɪl ɪts oʊld rulz/
dialogue.zh: 我們只寄紙本，沒有郵件，規定很舊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, that's honest at least, mail is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts ˈɑnɪst æt list meɪl ɪz ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，至少很誠實，寄紙本也好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It'll reach you in about a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪl ɹitʃ ju ɪn əˈbaʊt ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 大約一週你就會收到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A week, okay, so I just wait then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wik oʊˈkeɪ soʊ aɪ dʒʌst weɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 一週，好，那我就是等，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and if it's urgent, call this line.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ɪf ɪts ˈɜɹdʒənt kɔl ðɪs laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，要是有緊急狀況，就打這條專線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, I feel much better now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ aɪ fil mʌtʃ ˈbɛɾɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 了解了，我現在安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the goal, we try to keep it simple.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ɡoʊl wi tɹaɪ tə kip ɪt ˈsɪmpəl/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我們的目標，盡量把事辦簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You did, thank you for your patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd θæŋk ju fɔɹ jɔɹ ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 你做到了，謝謝你的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, Alan, see you in February.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ˈeɪlən si ju ɪn ˈfɛbʊˌɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 應該的，Alan，二月見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll be there, in real shoes, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl bi ðɛɹ ɪn ɹiːəl ʃuz hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 我會到的，穿像樣的鞋，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's all I ask, have a good one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɔːl aɪ æsk hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這就夠了，祝你順心。

script.youtube_title_en: "I Can't Close" — Calling the Court to Postpone Jury Duty
script.youtube_description:
「我實在走不開」——收到陪審團的信，可是店裡走不開，怎麼打給法院申請延期？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就是一通打進法院的電話。

你會聽到：開場說明要延期、報上傳票編號的完整說法；用小商家走不開當作理由該怎麼講；六個月改期、避開某週、選新日期的實用句；還有要帶什麼、穿什麼、有沒有津貼、確認怎麼寄。

整段只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人真實語感：um、well、so、ha。聽完你就會用：I'd like to postpone、How far can I、No worries、That's all I ask。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"I can't close" — a jury duty letter lands, but your little shop can't spare you. How do you call the court and postpone? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built around one phone call to the court.

You will hear: opening with a request to postpone, reading out the summons number; using a small business conflict as the reason; the six-month rule, avoiding a certain week, and picking a new date; plus what to bring, the dress code, the daily stipend, and how the confirmation arrives.

Everything stays in A2 words with real filler words Americans use: um, well, so, ha. By the end you'll own I'd like to postpone, How far can I, No worries, and That's all I ask.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
收到陪審團的信，可是店裡真的走不開，你該怎麼辦？傳票編號要唸給誰聽？能不能只打一通電話就把日子改掉？

這一集帶大家打進法院的服務專線，從說明要延期、報上傳票編號，一路聽到工作衝突的理由、六個月改期、要帶什麼、穿什麼，以及津貼與確認方式，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📨 開場句：Hi, I got a jury letter, I'd like to postpone.
🏛️ 說理由：I run a small shop, I can't close.
📞 改日期：So, how far can I push the date?
💵 問津貼：Nice, will I get paid for missing work?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、ha 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這通電話走一遍，下次真的收到信，你也能冷靜地把日期改好。

祝你事事都有轉圜的餘地。
script.thumbnail_action: holding a court summons letter to his ear like a phone
